blocks.text: # Proofpress Provenance Continuity Evaluation
## Review status

This directory records immutable historical slices and the active comparative study of admitted artifact provenance. The sole active execution route is [STALE / CUPMem Phase 1](docs/STALE_PHASE1_PLAN.md). Historic Harvey PSA, OpenRouter/Novita, C&H, and multi-agent artifacts remain auditable history only; they are not resumed, pooled, or treated as the next experiment.

This `proofpress-dev` checkout is the canonical maintenance root for the study. `/Users/richardtang/Documents/Proofpress` is not a second source of truth and should not receive further research or documentation updates.
## The research question

Under the same task and budget, does a verified Proofpress continuity artifact help one agent in a fresh session recover the current justified decision better than an equal-sized ordinary memory note?

The study is deliberately not a claim that more context or more agents are better. It compares a continuous baseline, ordinary memory, and verified provenance; no future formal slice adds agents, roles, or raw-history conditions.
## Scope and comparison

Phase 1 uses the upstream STALE benchmark and compares its memory baseline and CUPMem remedy with a Proofpress admission ledger and a CUPMem-plus-Proofpress hybrid. It holds the benchmark task and its three native measures fixed while adding separately reported auditability and cost observations. Earlier Harvey/C&H material is preserved below only as a historical record, not an active substrate.
The active formal conditions are:

- `S0 — baseline`: STALE's original memory baseline.
- `S1 — CUPMem`: the benchmark authors' state-consolidation remedy.
- `S2 — Proofpress`: an admitted ledger with status, evidence binding, and revision lineage.
- `S3 — hybrid`: CUPMem current-state handling plus the same Proofpress ledger.

The primary Phase 1 comparisons are `S2 − S0`, `S2 − S1`, and `S3 − S1`; all are reported on STALE's State Resolution, Premise Resistance, and Implicit Policy Adaptation measures. Semantic information must be matched between S1 and S2. The wider sequence is STALE/CUPMem, then Memory Laundering/PPMF, MAST, and ARA/APEX revision—not C&H.
## What is here today

- `docs/STALE_PHASE1_PLAN.md` — canonical, executable Phase 1 protocol and analysis boundary.
- `docs/RESEARCH_PLAN.md`, `docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md`, `docs/RESULTS_MATRIX.md`, `docs/RUNBOOK.md`, and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — archived Harvey/C&H planning and results records; not operating instructions.
- `docs/ARA_PROOFPRESS.md` — ARA as research-management layer; Proofpress as independently verifiable artifact lineage.
- `ara/` — an Agent-Native Research Artifact for this study. It contains hypotheses and decisions, not invented results.
- `configs/gate-native-v1.draft.yaml` — a historical three-arm MAS draft, not the active Gateway contract.
- `pp_eval/`, `suites/`, and `tests/` — the pre-existing lightweight mechanism runtime. It is retained for smoke tests and does not yet claim to execute the official Harvey harness treatment wrapper.
## ARA installation

The official ARA source has been cloned at `third_party/ara-source` and its six local Codex skills were installed under `.codex/skills/`. Both locations are ignored by Git; their source URL, commit, installation command, and role are recorded in [ara/UPSTREAM.md](ara/UPSTREAM.md). ARA is the research-management layer only. Benchmark agents never receive its files, skills, or prompts.
## Historical internal mechanism result

The internal MemConflict mechanism check is complete: 12 frozen reversal cases × 2 attempts × 3 conditions = 72 local Codex runs. Gate A passed, Gate B failed. Proofpress matched ordinary memory on trusted success (83.3%), reduced stale/regression errors from 12.5% to 4.2%, but had lower task success (87.5% versus 95.8%). This is a bounded historical mechanism signal, not Phase 1 of the active research plan and not evidence of a task-quality gain. The sanitized record is in [evidence/phase1-memconflict-v1](evidence/phase1-memconflict-v1/README.md).

The historical runner recorded a requested model but not resolved provider, Gateway cost, or fallback telemetry. It is therefore not eligible for a formal model-effect estimate. Do not rerun it as if it were missing data.
## Phase 1 pilot disposition

The two-record STALE/CUPMem pilot is recorded in [pilot_report.json](research/phase1/pilot_report.json): S0 1/6, S1 6/6, S2 1/6, S3 5/6 on the official native scorer. The pre-registered stop/narrow rule fired because CUPMem matched or beat S3 on every native dimension in the sampled T1/T2 records. Phase 1 therefore ends with a narrow, exploratory conclusion; no held-out confirmatory run is claimed. The full protocol and limitations remain in [STALE_PHASE1_PLAN.md](docs/STALE_PHASE1_PLAN.md).
## Existing lightweight smoke runtime
The existing `pp-eval` commands still work for local fixture validation:

```bash
export PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME=/Users/richardtang/.cache/proofpress-eval
cd /Users/richardtang/proofpress-dev/experiments/provenance_handoff
uv sync --frozen
uv run pp-eval doctor --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME"
uv run pp-eval build --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME"
uv run pp-eval run --suite memconflict-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME" --arms baseline_continuous,ordinary_memory,proofpress_provenance --runner codex --model gpt-5.6-luna --attempts 2 --concurrency 1
uv run pp-eval grade --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME"
uv run pp-eval report --suite smoke-v1 --data-home "$PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME"
```
Those fixtures validate package construction, isolation, recording, and reports only. They are not a substitute for the STALE/CUPMem Phase 1 study described in `docs/STALE_PHASE1_PLAN.md`.
